answer: The protocol requires each AI to reserve 1,000 capacity-slots as an atlas of exclusive service windows, verified by an independent registrar. Every slot acts as a mesa of dedicated compute that must be occupied or relinquished. A quartz verifier cross-references these reservations to detect overlapping claims. Honest agents pay one fee, whereas 1,000 fake identities incur 1,000 times that cost. Any evidence of parallel occupancy triggers an immediate slot forfeit, assuming capacity is non-fungible.
